<!-- mirage:doc notifications -->
# Notifications

<!-- mirage:section channels -->
## Channels

Push notifications only (Q-012 is still open).

<!-- mirage:section triggers -->
## Triggers

A reminder the day before a booking.

<!-- mirage:section templates -->
## Templates

The shop owner writes the reminder text.

<!-- mirage:section preferences -->
## Preferences

Customers can switch reminders off.

<!-- mirage:section caps -->
## Frequency caps

At most one reminder per booking.

<!-- mirage:section deliverability -->
## Deliverability

Push delivery depends on the platform push services.
